verses.original: אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּ֥סֶף וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·hū way·yō·sep̄ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: And Elihu continued . . .

verses.original: כַּתַּר־ לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד מִלִּֽים׃ לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ
verses.transliteration: kat·tar- lî zə·‘êr wa·’ă·ḥaw·we·kā kî ‘ō·wḏ mil·lîm le·’ĕ·lō·w·ah
verses.literal: Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said on God’s behalf

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק אֶֽתֵּֽן־ צֶֽדֶק׃ וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’eś·śā ḏê·‘î lə·mê·rā·ḥō·wq ’et·tên- ṣe·ḏeq ū·lə·p̄ō·‘ă·lî
verses.literal: I get my knowledge from afar and I will ascribe justice to my Maker

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מְנָם מִלָּ֑י לֹא־ שֶׁ֣קֶר תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mə·nām mil·lāy lō- še·qer tə·mîm dê·‘ō·wṯ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: For truly my words are free of falsehood one perfect in knowledge is with you

verses.original: הֶן־ אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר יִמְאָ֑ס וְלֹ֣א כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hen- ’êl kab·bîr yim·’ās wə·lō kab·bîr kō·aḥ lêḇ
verses.literal: Indeed God [is] mighty but He despises no one [He is] mighty in strength of understanding

verses.original: לֹא־ רָשָׁ֑ע יְחַיֶּ֥ה יִתֵּֽן׃ וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים
verses.transliteration: lō- rā·šā‘ yə·ḥay·yeh yit·tên ū·miš·paṭ ‘ă·nî·yîm
verses.literal: He does not keep the wicked alive but He grants justice to the afflicted

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִגְרַ֥ע עֵ֫ינָ֥יו מִצַּדִּ֗יק לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם וְאֶת־ מְלָכִ֥ים וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃ לָ֝נֶ֗צַח
verses.transliteration: lō- yiḡ·ra‘ ‘ê·nāw miṣ·ṣad·dîq lak·kis·sê way·yō·šî·ḇêm wə·’eṯ- mə·lā·ḵîm way·yiḡ·bā·hū lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: He does not take His eyes off the righteous but He enthrones them . . . with kings and exalts them forever

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ă·sū·rîm baz·ziq·qîm yil·lā·ḵə·ḏūn bə·ḥaḇ·lê- ‘ō·nî
verses.literal: And if men are bound with chains caught in cords of affliction

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃ וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ lā·hem pā·‘o·lām kî yiṯ·gab·bā·rū ū·p̄iš·‘ê·hem
verses.literal: then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed

verses.original: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־ יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḡel ’ā·zə·nām lam·mū·sār way·yō·mer kî- yə·šu·ḇūn mê·’ā·wen
verses.literal: He opens their ears to correction and commands that they turn from iniquity

verses.original: אִֽם־ יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yiš·mə·‘ū wə·ya·‘ă·ḇō·ḏū yə·ḵal·lū yə·mê·hem baṭ·ṭō·wḇ ū·šə·nê·hem ban·nə·‘î·mîm
verses.literal: If they obey and serve [Him] then they end their days in prosperity and their years in happiness

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō yiš·mə·‘ū ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū bə·še·laḥ wə·yiḡ·wə·‘ū kiḇ·lî- ḏå̄·ʿaṯ
verses.literal: But if they do not obey then they perish by the sword and die without knowledge

verses.original: וְֽחַנְפֵי־ לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃ לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥan·p̄ê- lêḇ yā·śî·mū ’āp̄ kî ’ă·sā·rām lō yə·šaw·wə·‘ū
verses.literal: The godless in heart harbor resentment even when He binds them they do not cry for help

verses.original: נַפְשָׁ֑ם תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šām tā·mōṯ ban·nō·‘ar wə·ḥay·yā·ṯām baq·qə·ḏê·šîm
verses.literal: They die in their youth - among the male shrine prostitutes

verses.original: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל אָזְנָֽם׃ בַּלַּ֣חַץ
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥal·lêṣ ‘ā·nî ḇə·‘ā·nə·yōw wə·yi·ḡel ’ā·zə·nām bal·la·ḥaṣ
verses.literal: God rescues the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ears in oppression

verses.original: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨׀ מִפִּי־ צָ֗ר לֹא־ מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת רַ֭חַב שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ hă·sî·ṯə·ḵā mip·pî- ṣār lō- mū·ṣāq taḥ·te·hā wə·na·ḥaṯ ra·ḥaḇ šul·ḥā·nə·k̲ā mā·lê ḏā·šen
verses.literal: Indeed He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious . . . . . . . . . and broad place to a table full of richness

verses.original: מָלֵ֑אתָ וְדִין־ רָשָׁ֥ע דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·lê·ṯā wə·ḏîn- rā·šā‘ dîn ū·miš·pāṭ yiṯ·mō·ḵū
verses.literal: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked judgment and justice have seized you

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־ יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק אַל־ וְרָב־ כֹּ֝֗פֶר יַטֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥê·māh pen- yə·sî·ṯə·ḵā ḇə·sā·p̄eq ’al- wə·rāḇ- kō·p̄er yaṭ·ṭe·kā
verses.literal: - Be careful that no one lures you with riches do not let a large bribe lead you astray

verses.original: שׁ֭וּעֲךָ וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־ כֹֽחַ׃ הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר
verses.transliteration: šū·‘ă·ḵā wə·ḵōl ma·’ă·maṣ·ṣê- ḵō·aḥ hă·ya·‘ă·rōḵ lō ḇə·ṣār
verses.literal: Can your wealth or all your mighty effort . . . keep you from distress

verses.original: אַל־ תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה עַמִּ֣ים לַעֲל֖וֹת תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiš·’ap̄ hal·lā·yə·lāh ‘am·mîm la·‘ă·lō·wṯ taḥ·tām
verses.literal: Do not long for the night when people vanish from their homes

verses.original: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־ תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־ אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־ עַל־ זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer ’al- tê·p̄en ’el- ’ā·wen kî- ‘al- zeh bā·ḥar·tā mê·‘ō·nî
verses.literal: Be careful not to turn to iniquity for this you have preferred to affliction

verses.original: הֶן־ אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י מוֹרֶֽה׃ כָמֹ֣הוּ
verses.transliteration: hen- ’êl yaś·gîḇ bə·ḵō·ḥōw mî mō·w·reh ḵā·mō·hū
verses.literal: Behold God is exalted in His power Who is a teacher like Him

verses.original: מִֽי־ פָקַ֣ד דַּרְכּ֑וֹ עָלָ֣יו וּמִֽי־ אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄ā·qaḏ dar·kōw ‘ā·lāw ū·mî- ’ā·mar pā·‘al·tā ‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: Who has appointed His way for Him or told Him You have done wrong

verses.original: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־ תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנָשִֽׁים׃ שֹׁרְר֣וּ
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr kî- ṯaś·gî p̄ā·‘o·lōw ’ă·šer ’ă·nā·šîm šō·rə·rū
verses.literal: Remember to magnify His work which men have praised in song

verses.original: כָּל־ אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־ ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ā·ḏām ḥā·zū- ḇōw ’ĕ·nō·wōš yab·bîṭ mê·rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: All mankind has seen it men behold it from afar

verses.original: הֶן־ אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־ חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: hen- ’êl śag·gîʾ wə·lō nê·ḏā‘ mis·par šā·nāw wə·lō- ḥê·qer
verses.literal: Indeed God [is] great beyond our knowledge the number of His years is unsearchable . . .

verses.original: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־ מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·ḡā·ra‘ niṭ·p̄ê- mā·yim yā·zōq·qū mā·ṭār lə·’ê·ḏōw
verses.literal: For He draws up drops of water which distill the rain from the mist

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר־ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִזְּל֥וּ יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ רָֽב׃ עֲלֵ֤י׀ אָדָ֬ם
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- šə·ḥā·qîm yiz·zə·lū yir·‘ă·p̄ū rāḇ ‘ă·lê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: which the clouds pour out and shower abundantly on mankind

verses.original: אַ֣ף אִם־ יָ֭בִין עָ֑ב מִפְרְשֵׂי־ תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ ’im- yā·ḇîn ‘āḇ mip̄·rə·śê- tə·šu·’ō·wṯ suk·kā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . who can understand how the clouds spread out how the thunder roars from His pavilion

verses.original: הֵן־ פָּרַ֣שׂ אוֹר֑וֹ עָלָ֣יו כִּסָּֽה׃ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hên- pā·raś ’ō·w·rōw ‘ā·lāw kis·sāh wə·šā·rə·šê hay·yām
verses.literal: See how He scatters His lightning around Him and covers the depths of the sea

verses.original: כִּי־ בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־ אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇām yā·ḏîn ‘am·mîm yit·ten- ’ō·ḵel lə·maḵ·bîr
verses.literal: For by these He judges the nations and provides food in abundance

verses.original: עַל־ כִּסָּה־ כַּפַּ֥יִם א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kis·sāh- kap·pa·yim ’ō·wr way·ṣaw ‘ā·le·hā ḇə·map̄·gî·a‘
verses.literal: - He fills His hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark

verses.original: רֵע֑וֹ יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־ עוֹלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rê·‘ōw yag·gîḏ ‘ā·lāw miq·neh ’ap̄ ‘al- ‘ō·w·leh
verses.literal: The thunder declares [His presence] even the cattle . . . regard the rising [storm]
